pkgmetadata.longdescription: vLLM is a fast and easy-to-use library for LLM inference and serving. It features high throughput via PagedAttention, continuous batching, optimized CUDA kernels (FlashAttention, FlashInfer), and support for a wide variety of model architectures and quantization methods.

use.flag: Build with NVIDIA CUDA GPU support
Enable gRPC serving endpoint (alternative to HTTP API)
